sculpt_wall_drystone.author: sculpted for this project
sculpt_wall_drystone.notes: 2.4 m dry-stone wall segment: three offset courses of rounded through-stones (bevel ring + dome), leaning cope on edge, dark hearting, moss on the cope (Moss_none). Courses tile end to end. Vertex colour only (linear). LOD tris 987 / 365 / 256.
